source.title: Sex difference in risk of torsade de pointes with d,l-sotalol.

items.quote: After adjustment for these risk factors, women had threefold greater odds of developing TdP than men.
items.claim: A sotalol analysis reported greater adjusted torsade odds in women.
items.study_design: Analysis of patients exposed to sotalol across clinical trials
items.relevance: Real sotalol context does not validate the mechanism or risks of fictional SYN-722.
limitations: Real published class-context evidence; not a study of the simulated compound.

source.title: Sex differences in drug-induced changes in ventricular repolarization.

items.quote: There were no sex differences in QTc prolongation for any drug, after accounting for differences in exposure.
items.claim: A small crossover study found no sex difference in exposure-adjusted QTc prolongation for its tested drugs.
items.relevance: QTc change and clinical torsade risk are different endpoints; populations and drugs differ.
limitations: Real published class-context evidence; not a study of the simulated compound.
